programme.title: Newscast
programme.desc: Join BBC journalists including political editor Laura Kuenssberg, Europe editor Katya Adler, Brussels correspondent Adam Fleming and political correspondent Chris Mason in their weekly podcast discussing all of the news stories that matter to the people of the United Kingdom. The journalists know all about the stories that they're talking about - they interview the most important people involved in the stories that feature in the news. They speak of their knowledge and understanding of the news in a way that is understandable for all. Laura is often in a car in the middle of a city where big politics stories are happening. Katya, Adam and Chris are usually in the studio. They regularly talk about Brexit and what is going to happen when the United Kingdom leaves the European Union.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. The BBC is aims to be a totally impartial public service broadcaster, and was established by Royal Charter. The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by British households, and is regulated by Ofcom. They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London.

programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. Broadcasting live at midnight GMT on both BBC World News and the BBC News channel, the show is broadcast in the morning in Asia and therefore is marketed as a morning show for people watching around the country. The show is often followed by Asia Business Report live from Singapore which reports on all the latest economy and business figures from the country.

programme.title: BBC World News America
programme.desc: News presenter Katty Kay keeps you up to date with all the latest breaking news from America and the rest of the world on BBC World News America. This world renowned news and current affairs program has been recognised for its exceptional reporting at the Emmy Awards. BBC World News America won two Emmy awards for its coverage of the conflicts in Syria and the Central African Republic. You can catch up with this award winning broadcast team as they air multiple times a day throughout the week.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights.

programme.desc: Valeria (Ana Valeria Becerril), 17, is pregnant. She lives in Puerto Vallarta, with Clara (Joanna Larequi), her half sister, who is calm, but lives with depression and is overweight. Valeria does not want her mother, April (Emma Suárez), who has been absent for a long time, to know about her pregnancy but, due to economic limitations and the overwhelming responsibility of having a baby at home, Clara decides to call her mother. April arrives with a great desire to see her daughters, but we soon see why Valeria did not want to get in touch with her. It is "the story of an adult woman who refuses to feel 'overtaken' by her own daughters in generational terms, without realising that she has been left behind in more important aspects, such as emotional and psychological, among others."

programme.title: The Hypnotist
programme.desc: Swedish thriller based on the best-selling novels of Lars Kepler. When a man and his family are found brutally murdered in a suburb outside Stockholm, Detective Inspector Joona Linna tries to persuade a doctor, Erik Maria Bark, to hypnotise a traumatised witness. But it has been ten years since Erik last practised hypnosis, and he has promised never to do it again. When he finally agrees, a chain of terrifying events starts.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: April And the Extraordinary World
programme.desc: April and the Extraordinary World is a 2015 French-Belgian-Canadian animated science fiction adventure film co-directed by Christian Desmares and Franck Ekinci. In 1870 on the eve of the Franco-Prussian War, French Emperor Napoleon III, accompanied by Marshal Bazaine, visits the lab of Gustave Franklin to access his project of breeding invulnerable supersoldiers. The emperor is disgusted with the results—two intelligent, talking komodo dragons ill-fit for war—and orders Bazaine to shoot them, but the creatures escape and the emperor instead causes an explosion that kills all three present. Napoleon III's successor then negotiates a settlement with Prussia to avert war, thus securing the throne to the House of Bonaparte.

programme.title: Flash Gordon
programme.desc: Mike Hodges' film is a gloriously kitsch update of the 1930s comic strip and film series, starring Sam J Jones as the American football star Flash Gordon, who's transported, along with the beautiful Dale Arden (Melody Anderson), by Dr Zarkov (Topol) into the realm of the most evil ruler in the universe, the Emperor Ming (Max von Sydow). Only by uniting those under Ming's merciless rule to join his revolution can Flash save Earth from destruction. The unashamedly over-the-top Queen soundtrack is matched by Danilo Donati's effervescent production design, and the film also stars Brian Blessed as the chief of the Hawkmen, Timothy Dalton as the leader of the Treemen, and Ornella Muti as Ming's daughter, whose lascivious designs on Flash are just one of the challenges he must overcome if he's to end Ming's tyranny.

programme.title: The Little Witch
programme.desc: The little witch is only 127-years-old, so just a youngster to the big witches. Despite being forbidden, she celebrates the Dance of the Witches on the Brocken Mountain on Walpurgis Night. As punishment, she has one year to learn the big book of spells by heart, and then her fate will be decided. Determined to be the best witch she can, she gets down to work, supported by her talking raven, Abraxas. At first reluctantly and then increasingly, she discovers helping people instead of annoying them with pranks makes her feel good. But the big witches, especially the scary weather witch Rumpumpel, are suspicious. For them, the last thing about being a really good witch is good deeds. And this puts the little witch in a terrible dilemma when it comes to her final test.

programme.title: Love Me No More
programme.desc: Antoine Méliot is around 40 years old and has everything he needs to be happy: a beautiful wife, two adorable children, friends he can count on, a pretty house in the Yvelines and money. But one day he decides to ruin everything in one weekend.

programme.title: The Princess of Montpensier
programme.desc: France, 1562. Against a background of the savage Catholic/Protestant wars, Marie de Mézières (Mélanie Thierry), a beautiful young aristocrat, and the rakish Henri de Guise (Gaspard Ulliel) fall in love, but Marie's father has promised her hand in marriage to the Prince of Montpensier (Grégoire Leprince-Ringuet). When he is called away to battle, her husband leaves her in the care of Count Chabannes (Lambert Wilson), an aging nobleman with a disdain for warfare. As he experiences his own forbidden desire for Marie, Chabannes must also protect her from the dangerously corrupt court dominated by Catherine de Medici.

programme.title: The Decoy Bride
programme.desc: Famous actress Lara Tyler can't get married to author James Arber without intrusive paparazzi crashing the ceremony. Because of James's best-seller, Lara's agent, Steve, checks out the little known Hegg Island in Scotland as the site for their next attempted wedding. Unfortunately, James is a hack, and his book (supposedly based on Hegg) relays little of it accurately. Katie, an island native and the only unmarried woman on it, has been unlucky in love. She's working on writing her own guide to Hegg Island when Steve and crew arrive, eventually hiring her as a reluctant decoy bride to distract the paparazzi. In a mix-up, she and James end up married to each other while Lara, having spotted the press, goes into hiding. Katie and James now have to get an island divorce while avoiding the press while other parties seek out Lara (who has disguised herself as one of the elderly islanders).

programme.desc: Two brothers and a sister witness the disappearance of their childhood memories when they must relinquish the family belongings to ensure their deceased mother's succession.

programme.title: S*** in a Good Way

programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: Gamechangers: Inventing the World
programme.desc: These pioneering gamechangers are working bring a sustainable future to our planet, transforming how we use science, technology and engineering to change societal outlooks. We follow the teams as they work across the entire world, from the deserted Australian outback to the tropical Amazon rainforests, as they design and test these advances in science. Whether it's testing the possibility of survival on Mars, ensuring potable water supplies or reducing carbon emissions, this fascinating documentary series inspires us to change the way we live.

programme.title: Intruders
programme.desc: If you thought you were safe at home, think again! Wild creatures and other pests who should be living outdoors make their way into your house on Animal Planet's new series, INTRUDERS. The series reveals real-life stories of homeowners fighting back to reclaim their homes when they've been invaded by snakes, over-run with rats, crawling with cockroaches and broken into by bears, among other invasions

programme.title: Jungle Shark
programme.desc: Dr. Craig O'Connell and Andy Casagrande travel up the Serena River to try and find out why young bull sharks swim up the river, and how they avoid the crocodiles living there.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Dogs: The Untold Story is an amazing documentary series providing us with unbelievable stories, research results and facts about our best friends, healers and protectors- dogs. They have evolved from predators to favourite pets, adored by millions people all over the world. They can understand people and even talk to them, they have been by human's side for more than 33.000 years. Dogs are actually more incredible than anyone has ever imagined.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: House Of Knives
programme.desc: Chefs compete in a cold dish challenge. Despite one's confidence, they almost cause a fire. The Council awards control to someone who reimagined a classic. Their strategic choice shocks all. A chicken battle offers revenge.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: These Woods Are Haunted
programme.desc: The great outdoors is full of mystery and beauty, but nobody expects to run into paranormal entities or monstrous creatures during a normal day out. This documentary series examines terrifying tales where individuals have found themselves coming into contact with unexplained phenomena. What was supposed to be a pleasant trip soon turns into a nightmare, and with dramatic reconstructions, their frightening ordeals are brought to life. Each episode explores a respective story, featuring interviews with the individuals involved alongside the re-enactments.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Missing
programme.desc: This documentary crime show is about uncovering and seeking out the truth into the mystery of the most shocking disperse that have taken place over the years. The cold case that no one seem to be able to solve laving people to believe in the supernatural and family wondering why and how. Leaving the people left be hide baffled and to try to discovery what has happen. To do this they will use the science and technol of today to try to uncover what has taken place on these mystery day. Follow the presenter as he deep dive into to the world of the unknown.

programme.title: The Alaska Triangle
programme.desc: Experts and eyewitnesses attempt to unlock the mystery of the Alaska Triangle, a remote area infamous for alien abductions, Bigfoot sightings, paranormal phenomena and vanishing airplanes. Throughout the series, we meet a woman whose idyllic Alaskan dream soon descends into a paranormal nightmare, as she starts to suffer attacks by an unseen force. Recent sightings may prove that a Native American legend about a mysterious race of giants is true. The series also explores The Missing Douglas and whether an interdimensional portal in the Alaska Triangle led to the disappearance of the airplane carrying 44 military personnel in 1950.

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files
programme.desc: What do we really know about life beyond the realm of our planet? Disturbing discoveries about the rest of our universe have perplexed scientists, and the rest of the world, for as long as we can remember. Now, the files and discoveries of one of the worlds biggest independent agencies have been dug up, for thorough investigation. Each episode scrutinises questionable evidence, encounters and sightings, to shed some light on the unexplained files of NASA. Featuring testimonies of NASA insiders and scientists who have first hand experience of the enigmas, laying within our universe.

programme.title: Ice Cold Gold
programme.desc: ICE COLD GOLD spotlights a spirited team of miners who are among the first Americans to prospect for precious metals and gems in parts of Greenland where humans never have set foot before. The six-part series follows eight men who leave behind their families, friends and homeland to strike it rich against all odds while struggling to survive against the harshest of conditions. Greenland's a veritable beast, but the motley crew of ICE COLD GOLD miners is up for the challenge. Each thinks he has what it takes to walk away with gold, rubies and sapphires before winter and large mining companies swoop in. What transpires as the miners cope with the unpredictable, harsh unknown? Are they humbled by their journey? Do their personalities get in the way? Most importantly, do they strike ICE COLD GOLD?ed ice sheets.

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: Scrappers
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

The role of the security forces is manifold: from the fight against hashish transport in the strait of Gibraltar to the smashing of organized human trafficking at the airport in Madrid to the search for counterfeit branded goods in the port of Barcelona.

programme.title: Kindig Customs: Road To The Ridler
programme.desc: The pinnacle of the custom car world is the Don Ridler Award, given out every year at the Detroit Autorama. Dave Kindig has always had a Ridler-sized itch he needed to scratch, and has finally found the right client and idea to make it a reality.

programme.title: Mike Brewer: Born Dealer
programme.desc: Mike trades a classic Citroen for an F-Type Jag. Later, he visits a classic car auction to test the market and tries his hand at Crown Green Bowls.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. Using real footage from the officer's body cameras, we show just how deadly routine checks can be, with law enforcement officials having to think on their feet and make split-second decisions to potentially save their, or someone else's, life. From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. With interviews from the officers involved adding context to the footage, Body Cam Cops gives viewers unprecedented, exclusive access to what life is truly like in the line of duty.

programme.title: Border Control Sweden
programme.desc: The security and customs services at the border of Sweden are on constant watch to stop illegal items entering the country. It's their job to detect crime.

programme.title: The Bad Foot Clinic
programme.desc: Severe fungal foot and nail infections, warts, corns, webbed toes, bunions and verrucas are all in a day's work for leading podiatrist Marion Yau and her GP husband Dr Kenny. Together, they tackle extreme and debilitating foot conditions.

programme.title: About Face
programme.desc: When faced with treating a man whose cheek is about to pop due to a 4lb tumor, Dr. Panossian worries it could become a deadly situation. A woman who's lower lip won't stop growing turns to Dr. Rovelo for help.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs." Tune in for a sneak peek of 7 Little Johnstons on Sunday, April 14th at 10/9c. (Source: OWN)

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé UK
programme.desc: Charlotte develops trust issues with Johan, and Jamie's big reunion with Kathleen is ruined due to lingering issues from his prior cheating.

programme.title: Love & Translation
programme.desc: The series brings three American men and 12 international women together on a remote paradise island for a chance at finding romance. And here's the twist: none of the women speak English and none of the men speak other languages. Without being able to speak to one another and without the use of translators, the singles need to count on their senses to help develop their connection and determine the power of their chemistry and attraction.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: The Face Doctors
programme.desc: From devastating genetic conditions to trauma and illness, the series follows patients undergoing life-changing surgery and cutting-edge treatment to rebuild their faces. A team of surgeons and prosthetists work together to change lives.

programme.title: Northwoods Survival
programme.desc: In the Yukon, Margot takes her fledgling dog sled team on their inaugural multi-day trapping trip. Billy takes to the woods in search of a more traditional way of living off and on the land. Matty goes all in on the renovation of his ancient Newfoundland seaside home, while Emilie and Gilbert take advantage of an early freeze-up and head out trapping, in search of an essential resource that makes its winter home beneath the ice. programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: Dubai International is in the global race to be the world's biggest airport. A massive new concourse for the world's largest fleet of A380's uses over a 150 million man-hours and 930 thousand cubic meters of concrete. Unafraid of new challenges, the airport was the first ever to close two runways back to back for construction. In the words of its Engineering CEO, "the bar is getting higher and higher." There is no room for failure in Dubai.

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: More than a million passengers pass through Dubai International Airport every week. Behind the scenes 60,000 people from across the globe are hard at work. From ensuring the safety of the runway surface to dealing with drunken passengers, this episode of "Ultimate Airport" offers a rare chance to get to know the unsung men and women carrying out the often overlooked but vital tasks that make this multi-billion dollar airport run smoothly.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Maya Snake Kings
programme.desc: Fascinating documentary series from National Geographic that sheds new light on the mystifying Maya civilisation. With astounding new evidence, scientists, archaeologists and historians have uncovered the complexity and advancement of this Central American civilisation, which lived across southeastern Mexico, Belize, Honduras, El Salvador and Guatemala. These experts have used advanced technology to scour the jungles of Guatemala, discovering approximately 60,000 new structures that reveal the meandering network of infrastructure which connected the Maya people. One of the ruling dynasties of this ancient era were the Snake Kings, who until recently were unknown. These intriguing new discoveries reveal the extent of the Snake Kings power as they even conquered Tikal, the greatest city in Mayan history.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. Unraveling the complex mystery is a painstaking process that takes months—and sometimes years—of detective work. The twisted wreckage at the crash site tells part of the story; investigators can use it to learn about the final seconds of a flight and rule out mechanical failures. The flight data and cockpit voice recorders are critical, but they don't always reveal what happened. It almost always takes a tragic combination of factors to bring down an airplane.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. programme.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry journeys across islands, mountains and olive groves to reveal why ancient Greece was the birthplace of so many big ideas. From sailing old trade routes through the Aegean to marvelling at the optical illusions hidden in the Parthenon, she explores how ideas were shaped by the dramatic landscape and how a mastery of maths, architecture and navigation fuelled a golden age of progress and innovation. Exploring the threads between ancient and modern Greece, she joins a family of olive farmers in Crete preserving centuries-old traditions, and visits the mountaintop monasteries in Meteora, where nuns safeguard classical texts. In the coastal town of Galaxidi, she's swept up in a riotous flour-throwing festival that blends ancient myth with modern identity.

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry travels to Vietnam, a land of staggering natural beauty, ancient traditions and some of the fastest growing skylines on earth. Over 1,600 km from the vibrant South to the historic North, she uncovers the story of the country's remarkable post-war transformation. She immerses herself in the moped chaos in Ho Chi Minh City, helps with a muddy prawn harvest in the Mekong Delta and takes a restorative spa bath in the misty hilltops of Sapa. She ushers in the New Year with a local family celebrating the Tet festival and learns how a beloved dish, pho, tells a story of identity. In each place she visits, she meets characters whose lives have been shaped by both war and renewal. What emerges is a nation embracing change, where striking contrasts are balanced by a spirit of cooperation and strong family bonds.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: In Iraq, archaeologists investigate the truth behind the legendary city of Babylon. First discovered in the 1800s, this vast ancient metropolis was home to extraordinary structures and a long line of notorious rulers. Babylon is one of the most famous cities in the Bible, mentioned hundreds of times, from the first book of Genesis to Revelation. But why did it have such a hold over the writers of the Bible? International teams of experts investigate ancient cities across Mesopotamia, which could shed light on this mystery. From the cultural wonders and dramatic history of Nineveh to the extraordinary ziggurat at Dur-Kurigalzu, exploring these sites helps reveal the real world of Babylon and illuminate why it was such a source of inspiration and fascination for the Bible's authors.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: The book of Revelation tells of an apocalyptic battle of good versus evil at the end of the world. It says the battle will happen in a place called Armageddon, but Armageddon is no myth. It takes its name from a real ancient settlement: Megiddo. So, what happened here to inspire a Biblical tale of such drama? Archaeologists believe that a series of battles took place here over several centuries, which may have given Megiddo a reputation for violence, turmoil and war as a series of powerful civilizations claimed it as their own. The Egyptians, Assyrians and — according to the Bible — the Israelites all flattened and then rebuilt the city. Finally, it was the site of a battle between King Josiah, the last of the line of King David, and the Egyptians, resulting in Josiah's death. Could these events be the origins of the Armageddon story?

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: An oversized billboard falls down in Mumbai, causing death and destruction. In Minnesota, too much snow leads to roofs collapsing. A volcano erupts, creating widespread infrastructure damage. A bridge in Pittsburgh plummets to the valley below, taking with it cars and a bus. While digging new subway tunnels in São Paulo, the ground caves in, not once, but twice. Home renovations spark outrage, and eerie abandoned skyscrapers, or "ghost-scrapers," remain unfinished.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: One of the world's deadliest natural disasters wreaks havoc across the Spanish province of Valencia in a flash. Cable car rides go from scenic to scary in a snap, an airport parking garage in the UK goes up in flames, and the canopy of a Serbian train station comes down with a bang. A large Romanian bridge has even bigger construction problems, and a few British bike paths have questionable design decisions.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: In Thailand, elevated highways keep falling down. A fire breaks out at a bakery in a Uruguayan shopping mall, and a bridge in Colombia collapses just before construction is finished. London's skyline has become a buffet of unsightly skyscrapers, and trucks everywhere are overloaded. Without proper shoring, a building in Iowa crumbles and houses in Rodanthe keep plunging into the ocean.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Ghost Ships of the Great Lakes: Lost Beneath the Waves
programme.desc: The tempestuous Great Lakes are full of wrecks lost to the depths and time. In this update, new science reveals some of the exciting Great Lakes ship discoveries over the last decade, and allows for the exploration and recovery of recently discovered wrecks, including a mysterious group of ships that haven't been seen since 1914.

programme.title: Buried Secrets of Cordoba
programme.desc: National Geographic follows archaeologist and explorer Fabio Amador on a fascinating voyage to unveil the ancient mysteries that lie beneath the modern streets of Cordoba, which dates back some 2,000 years. Fabio joins archaeologists and historians in the field as they use state-of-the-art technologies to discover and recreate Cordoba's forgotten past.

programme.title: Endurance
programme.desc: In a legendary feat of leadership and perseverance, Antarctic explorer Ernest Shackleton kept his crew alive for over a year despite losing their ship in frigid pack ice. A century later, a team of explorers sets out to find the sunken ship. These landmark expeditions, bound by shared grit and determination, bookend one of history's greatest sagas of survival and the power of the human spirit.

programme.title: Titanic: The Digital Resurrection
programme.desc: Using cutting-edge scanning technology and state-of-the-art CGI, a team of experts produces the first high-res, 3D digital twin of the wreck of the Titanic. Through an unprecedented immersive investigation, the team reveals the ship's fateful final moments, the heroics and cowardice of those on board, and the truth about how the "unsinkable" ship sank.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport employees reunite travelers with their lost items, including a pair of ornate Shriners fezzes, a bride's pearl necklace, and a $12,000 Jaeger watch. In New Orleans, a mom retrieves the wallet she left on the plane after buying snacks for her kids, and in Alabama shoppers from around the country line up for hours to enter Unclaimed Baggage's giant annual sale of lost ski equipment.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport workers undertake true detective work to trace the owner of a duffel bag brimming with old family photos. A woman searches for Christmas decorations that are part of a family gifting tradition. In Tampa, the lost and found department donates items to a local women's shelter, including a $700 purse. In New Orleans, a young man loses his wallet upon arriving for a college tour.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Space shuttle Columbia, the Deepwater Horizon oil rig, and the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant are three major disasters linked to engineering and design flaws. Now, using the latest research and evidence along with 3D reconstructions, experts rewind the day of each disaster, dissect the chain of events, and pinpoint the warnings and design choices that turned failures into catastrophes. What turned Columbia's return into a disaster? Why didn't the oil rig's final defenses hold? And how did a massive wave defeat emergency backups?

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: A construction crane in the heart of New York City, Italy's iconic Morandi Bridge, and a multistory department store in Korea — three major disasters linked to engineering errors. Now, using the latest research and evidence along with 3D reconstructions, experts rewind the day of each disaster, dissect the chain of events, and pinpoint the warnings and design flaws that spiraled into structural collapse. How does a series of oversights, design flaws, and negligent decisions lead to deadly catastrophes?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. Unraveling the complex mystery is a painstaking process that takes months—and sometimes years—of detective work. The twisted wreckage at the crash site tells part of the story; investigators can use it to learn about the final seconds of a flight and rule out mechanical failures. The flight data and cockpit voice recorders are critical, but they don't always reveal what happened. It almost always takes a tragic combination of factors to bring down an airplane.

programme.title: Northwoods Survival
programme.desc: Margot and her canine friends continue their pioneering trapping adventure, pushing deeper into the rugged Yukon backcountry. Desperate for building materials for his island homestead, Matty takes to the seas in search of timber. Billy turns his attention to fixing one of the most essential of all backwoods buildings: the outhouse. Emilie and Gilbert take their daughter Annie on her first hunting trip.

programme.title: Northwoods Survival
programme.desc: Margot and a "special friend" make a final push to complete her cabin before winter fully sets in. Despite a big dump of snow, Billy heads into the bush to embark on an ambitious bridge building project. Matty enlists a "ringer" from his past to help him beat out a fast-approaching storm. And Emilie and Gilbert make a harrowing journey into the backcountry to deliver precious cargo, essential for the completion of their Northwoods dream home.

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: To maintain its place as one of the busiest airports in the world, Dubai International needs to run like clockwork. Failure in any single department can have major consequences across the whole airport. This episode follows an emergency in air traffic control that leads to a runway closure, a huge task to re-number every departure gate in the airport while it is operational, and the mounting tension on the building site of a new $3.2 billion terminal extension - built specifically to accommodate the A380, the world's biggest passenger airliner.

programme.desc: . Noortekomöödia "Öölapsed" räägib kolmest õest, kes on jõudnud oma elus murdepunktini. Äsja gümnaasiumi lõpetanud Liis (Grete Konksi) avastab, et planeeritud tulevik poiss-sõbraga ei olegi nii kindel. Vanem õde Karin (Piret Krumm) on esimene pesast lahkunud pääsuke, kes püüab toime tulla tänapäeva seksistlikus ärikeskkonnas. Õdedest noorim, teismeline Jane (Alice Siil) püüab vastu hakata peoloomast sõbranna survele olla keegi, kes ta tegelikult ei ole. Ühe saatusliku öö jooksul paljastuvad saladused ja tunded, mida ükski õdedest endale varem tunnistada pole tahtnud. Lavastaja:Priit PääsukeOsades:Piret Krumm, Grete Konksi, Alice Siil, Mart Müürisepp, Kristjan Lüüs, Alo Kõrve, Liis Lemsalu, Peeter Oja, Laine Mägi, Argo Aadli, Lauri Pedaja, Ott Lepland, Juss Haasma, Jaune Kimmel, Liisa Saaremäel, Miika Pihlak, Amanda Hermiine Künnapas.

programme.title: Kala kõlab hästi
programme.desc: Saatesarja esimene osa viib Saaremaale, kus Kalev Kruus kohtub kalurite Aini ja Martiniga ning saare suurima kalasuitsutaja Tiinaga. Loomulikult astub üles ka sealsete vete superstaar – lest. Mida selle väärt kalaga peale hakata, saad õppida juba koos Kaleviga.

programme.title: Doktor Silva
programme.desc: Väikese maakoha perearstikeskusse tuleb tööle uus ja peen perearst Tallinnast – doktor Silva, kes on harjunud ooperis käima, kalamarja sööma ja kübaraid kandma. Nüüd peab pealinna daam kohanema aga hoopis uue ja otsekohesema elustiiliga. Lisaks punuvad tema vastu intriige perearstikeskusest vallandatud endine perearst Heimar ja pereõde Ester. Kange iseloomuga Doktor Silva ei kohku aga tagasi ja hakkab tegelema kohaliku rahva eriskummaliste haigusjuhtumitega, üritab külarahva umbusuga võidelda ja kõigele lisaks varjab ta oma hingesopis hämarat saladust, mis oli tema pealinnast pagemise põhjuseks.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Igavlevad Franky (Franck Gastambide) ja Krimo (Malik Bentalha) unistavad reisist Taisse, troopilisse Pattaya kuurorti. Raha säästmiseks registreerivad nad oma sõbra Karimi (Anouar Toubali) salaja Muay Thai kääbuste maailmameistrivõistlustele. Unistuste puhkusest saab aga nende elu kõige hullumeelsem ja ohtlikum seiklus.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Ambitsioonikas filminäitlejanna Penny kolib Pasadena korterisse, mis asub säravate ja sotsiaalselt kohmakate füüsikute Sheldon Cooperi ja Leonard Hofstadteri vastas ning näitab neile, kui vähe nad teavad elust väljaspool laborit.

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Võõrad ründavad Susanne Königi lapsehoidjat ja Susanne'i poega Friedrichit. Semir ja Paul hakkavad kurjategijate jälgi ajama ning satuvad Susanne'i endise kavaleri Tommy Gerhardti peale, kes on äsja tingimisi vabaks saanud. Susanne peab langetama ülitähtsa otsuse.

programme.title: Walker, Texase korravalvur
programme.desc: Walkeril ja Trivette'il tuleb tegemist äärmuslike rassistidega, kes ei peatu millegi ees.

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Semir otsustab enne oma 50. sünnipäeva töölt lahkuda. Ta vana sõber Ben ilmub välja ning ta peab selle tõttu oma minevikuga silmitsi seisma. Paul ei ole kindel, kui kaua ta saab veel oma dementse isaga koos aega veeta, enne kui ta seisund hullemaks läheb.

programme.title: Simpsonid
programme.desc: Marge läheb Barti ja Lisaga ekskursioonile. Ootamatu käik restorani avab nende maitsemeeled ja Marge otsustab hakata kahe toidufänniga koos toidublogi pidama. Blogijad kutsutakse Springfieldi parimasse restorani, aga Marge näeb halba und, mis tekitab temas kahtlusi, kas tasub Homer restorani kaasa võtta.

programme.title: Ameerika paps
programme.desc: Koolikiusaja päästab Steve'i elu karnevalil. Kõik peavad meest kohalikuks kangelaseks.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Sheldon ja Amy teevad valentinipäeva puhul erisaate. Leonard ja Penny ei taha leppida sellega, et nad jäävad vanemaks. Howard ja Bernadette leiavad mullivannist üllatuse. Raj ei tea, kas valida Emily või koomiksipoes kohatud tüdruk.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Kui kamp kuuleb Bernadette'i raseduse kohta, tähistatakse seda karaoke laulmisega. Bernadette'ile teeb muret, kui Wolowitz läheb rasedusest kuuldes endast välja. Wolowitz on veendunud, et ta peab lapse jaoks raha teenima.

programme.title: Rünnak 13. jaoskonnale
programme.desc: 31. detsember Detroidi vanimas, sulgemist ootavas 13. politseijaoskonnas. Väljas möllava lumetormi tõttu on tööl vaid üksikud, keda juhib seersant Jake Roenick (Ethan Hawke), kogenud politseinik, keda piinavad mälestused halvasti lõppenud varitsusoperatsioonist. Tormi tõttu läbimatuks muutunud tänavalt pöördub 13. jaoskonda vanglabuss, mille reisijate seas on kurikuulus jõugupealik Marion Bishop (Laurence Fishburne). Tema ja teised vahistatud paigutatakse jaoskonna kongidesse tormi vaibumist ootama ja kõik näib olevat kontrolli all... Kuni jaoskonda ründavad relvastatud sissetungijad. Nad õnnestub vaevu tagasi lüüa, kuid on selge, et sellega asi ei lõpe. Hoone piirajad tahavad Bishopi kätte saada ega põrku tagasi ka kõigi majas viibijate tapmisest. Muust maailmast äralõigatud seltskonnal ei jää üle muud, kui ühendada jõud ja võidelda, sest vaid nii on neil lootust ellu jääda. PS: Alla 12 aastastele ei soovitata (K-12)!

programme.title: Teel jalgpalli MM-ile. Episode 8
programme.desc: 12-osaline sari tutvustab sel suvel USA-s, Kanadas ja Mehhikos toimuva maailma suurima jalgpallipeo meeskondi ja staare. Iga osa toob vaatajateni neli finaalturniiril osalevat rahvuskoondist. Ajalooliste hetkede taustal jõuavad ekraanile mängijate emotsioonid, mõtted ning haaravad lood, mis muudavad eelseisva MM-turniiri kogu maailma ühendavaks spordisündmuseks.

programme.title: Suvesangarid
programme.desc: "Suvesangarid" on lustlik suvine saade, mis tõestab, et igas Eestimaa nurgas on midagi vaatamist ja katsetamist väärt. Kartmatud saatejuhid Indrek Vaheoja ja Kristjan Rabi proovivad erinevaid ameteid, võtavad vastu külalisi ja jagavad ellujäämise saladusi neljal õhtul nädalas. Lisaks saab Eestimaa kirjust suvest osa vaatajate koduvideote kaudu.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.desc: Heidame pilgu maailma suurlinnade kõige võrratumatele raudteedele, alates Wuppertali tagurpidi monorelssteest Saksamaal, kuni Londoni pöördelise Crossraili projekti ning New Yorgi kaubaveosüsteemini.

Piret kohtub ootamatult Lauriga ja läheb tülli Voltsiga. Inna teeb Albertile üllatava ettepaneku. Erik ähvardab Andrest.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Sotsiaalmeedia staaril Briannal võib olla küll tuhandeid jälgijaid, kuid tema ihkab ühte hingesugulast, kellega rambivalgust jagada. Kas tema pluss-üheks võiks saada võluv britt Will? Otsekohene kaevur Rachelle kohtub 26-aastase ehitaja Adamiga. Kas temaga võib tekkida igatsetud keemia? Järjekindel romantik Shadi teeb kolmanda katse armastust leida ja kabareelaulja Danielle tundub huvitatud.

programme.title: Armastuse hind
programme.desc: Ferit kohtub Sunaga ja Suna näeb Feritit nüüd hoopis teise nurga alt. Suna tunneb end väga üksi. Sehmuzi pool püütakse aru saada, kes Serter on ja mida ta sealt otsib. Orhan saab kaela uue süüdistuse teo eest, mida ta pole sooritanud, ent ta võetakse selle eest vastutusele. Sehmuz ja Serter saabuvad häärberisse Pelini järele. Pelin on endast täiesti väljas.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Minu köök on parim: Uus-Meremaa

programme.title: Käthe ja mina

Pauli abi vajab õnnetusejärgselt pikalt koomas olnud Maria, kel puudub elutahe, kuna tema mees on ta vahepeal teise naise vastu välja vahetanud. Paul püüab naises võitlusvaimu äratada, et too terveneks. Paul igatseb oma naist Erinat ja valmistub tema kojutulekuks.

programme.title: Saatmata kirjade lood

programme.title: Luksuskinnisvarahaid
programme.desc: Gavini oksjon toob kaasa ebakindluse. Simon teeb ringkäigu elegantselt renoveeritud kinnisvaras, mis võiks huvitada uut välismais klienti. Samal ajal püüab D'Leanne saada uut kinisvara - kas ta suudab sõlmida tehingu nii konkureerival turul?

programme.title: Jamie tervislikud road
programme.desc: Seekord näitab Jamie ajule kasulike toitude valmistamist: plaadiroog lõhega, pošeeritud aromaatsed kanapallid ning spinati-läätsepannkoogid. Lisaks õpetab ta kiudaineid nautima oma lihtsate muna-oa filotainakeerdudega ning dekadentliku, ent tervisliku magustoiduga.

programme.desc: Õeks õppival Sarah'l on kindlad reeglid: ta ei suudle, ei jaga toitu, enne 10. kohtingut ei seksi. Pankur Melvin püüab olla sarmikas, aga kardab, et jätab kohmetu mulje. Ta kohtub arstist Jessicaga, kelle elutempo on suhete jaoks liiga kiire. Baari juhataja Bunny on "üks poiste seast", parameedik Andy otsib naist, kes talle väljakutse esitaks. Tegevjuht Matt kohtub pluss-suuruses modelli Annalise'iga.

Ja isegi kui mõni teema neid vaidlema paneb, leitakse sõbralikult koos lahendus igale küsimusele. Näitlejad Maarja Johanna Mägi ja Aaron Thor Härm, režissöör Kristo Veinberg, stsenarist Laura Kõrvits, produtsent Kadi Katarina Priske.

programme.title: Claude

programme.title: Oodo
programme.desc: Oodo täidab usinalt oma linnusulgede albumit, kust tal on puudu ainult üks sulg - inspektor Suleste oma. Paraku on Suleste nii väärikas ja aukartust äratav, et väikelindudel kipuvad temaga rääkides sõnad suus sassi minema.

programme.title: Ruudu ja Tupsu

programme.title: Magus molekul
programme.desc: Kui pikk on maailma pikim porgand? Kas porgandid on ainult oranži värvi? Kas porgandi saab ka painduvaks muuta? Kõikidele küsimustele saad vastused saatesarja teise hooaja esimeses saates. Režissöör Ivan Pavljutskov, toimetaja Helen Saluveer, produtsent Maria Uppin ja tootja Black Plastic Media Productions. Saatesarja toetavad Vivita Estonia, Eesti Teadusagentuur ja Maaeluministeerium.

programme.title: Eesti muusika
programme.desc: "Kekskasti kool" on Arne Oidi ja Ellen Niidu tuntud lastelaul, mis kõlas ka 1974.aasta saates "On meie keskel suvi". Solistid on õed Klarika ja Kirsti Kuusk koos Entel-Tenteli laululaste ja ETV ansambliga Kustas Kikerpuu juhatusel.

programme.title: Vahva rätsep
programme.desc: Elas kord vaene rätsep, kes päevast päeva aina õmbles vammuseid ja paikas pükse. Kord ostis ta talunaiselt moosi, otsustas aga mõnusa suutäie jätta preemiaks, kui töö tehtud saab. Magus lõhn meelitas kohale kärbsed. Rätsep vihastas, võttis hoogu ja lõi seitse kärbest korraga laiaks. Omaenese vahvust imetledes tikkis ta enda vööle kirja SEITSE ÜHE HOOBIGA ja läks maailma õnne otsima. Vendade Grimmide muinasjutu järgi valminud filmi lavastas Christian Theede.

programme.title: Nõiakivi
programme.desc: Mitte väga kaugel loomalaste kodudest seisab keset metsalagendikku hall ja sammaldunud kivi, mis juhuslikule möödujale ei reeda mitte millegagi oma saladust. Lustliku õudusloo Kivinõia pahategudest kirjutas Heljo Mänd.

programme.title: Rakett 69
programme.desc: Rakett 69 hoiab korda piiripunktis. Et turul ei tekiks ebavõrdset olukorda, tuleb võistlejatel arvestada piiriületajate sõidukitest avastatud kolme eri liiki kütuse aktsiisi. Seadusliku piiriületuse tagamiseks peavad raketlased veenduma, kas inimene üritab piiri ületada enda või kellegi teise dokumendiga. Tootja Vesilind OÜ.

programme.title: Teel jalgpalli MM 2026 finaalturniirile
programme.desc: 12-osaline sari tutvustab sel suvel USA-s, Kanadas ja Mehhikos toimuva maailma suurima jalgpallipeo meeskondi ja staare. Iga osa toob vaatajateni neli finaalturniiril osalevat rahvuskoondist. Ajalooliste hetkede taustal jõuavad ekraanile mängijate emotsioonid, mõtted ning haaravad lood, mis muudavad eelseisva MM-turniiri kogu maailma ühendavaks spordisündmuseks.

programme.title: Erakordsed Šveitsi mägiraudteed
programme.desc: 2000-meetriselt Rochers de Naye mäelt avaneb vaade Genfi järvele. Mäetipust paistavad kätte lumised mäed ja majesteetlik Mont Blanc ise, mis on Euroopa kõrgeim mägi. 1892. aastast on sealne raudtee ühendanud Montreux' rivierat selle kauni alpivaatega.

programme.title: Maahommiku lood

programme.title: Riigikogu infotund

programme.title: Esimene stuudio
programme.desc: Saatesari avab erinevaid päevakajalisi teemasid, mis sünnivad meie igapäeva-elust, alates poliitikast ja majandusest, lõpetades sotsiaalia ning kultuuriga. Saatejuhid Andres Kuusk, Johannes Tralla ja Mirko Ojakivi. Režissöör Maarika Lauri, produtsent Tiina-Mari Koljak.

programme.title: Teemaõhtu
programme.desc: Mati Kaal juhtis Tallinna Loomaaeda pea pool sajandit. Mehe enda sõnul oli tegemist tööga, kus iga päev oli eelmisest erinev ja alati oli oodata midagi uut. Käisime legendaarsel loodusesõbral Tallinna Loomaaias külas ja ka seekordne päev tõi elevust ning üllatusi. Saate tegid Maria Kivirand ja Robi Uppin. Täna on Mati Kaalu 80. sünnipäev. Palju õnne!

programme.title: Osoon
programme.desc: 25. augustil 1939. aastal avas Eesti Looduskaitse Liit 1843. aastaks kavandatud üleriikliku iluaiandusnäituse osana Kadrioru Väikese Loomaaia. Esimeseks eksponaadiks oli ilves Illu. Kodumaiste rebaste, metskitsede, karude, mäkrade kõrval võis näha ka lõvisid, ahve, dingosid ja teisi loomi. 1939. aasta lõpuks oli loomaaeda külastanud juba 100 tuhat inimest. 1983. aastal kolis loomaaed Kadriorust Veskimetsa. Endised sõjaväelaod kohaldati loomadele elamiseks. Esimesed õnnelikud olid paksunahalised, kes said 1989. aastal oma maja, hiljem ehitati troopikamaja, elevandimaja, alpinaarium, polaarium, aga kaugeltki kõigil loomaaia elanikel pole nii hästi läinud. Vaatame, kuidas elab Tallinna Loomaaed juubeliaastal. Autorid Kristo Elias ja Sander Loite. Režissöör Keiti Väliste, operaatorid Ott Tiigirand ja Simmo Saska, heli Taisto Uuslail, toimetaja-produtsent Õie Arusoo.

programme.title: Osooni lood
programme.desc: Eestis on rattasõit rohkem hobi, igapäevaselt kodu ja töö vahet liiklejaid märkab vähem. Tallinna tänavapildis võib näha turiste vedavaid velorattaid, kuid kaubaratas on pigem haruldus. Autor Kristo Elias.

programme.title: Stella ja Sam
programme.desc: 9-aastane Stella pole oma 4-aastasele vennale üksnes vanem õde, vaid ka parim sõber ja teejuht nende tagaaia maagilises maailmas. Stellale pole aed lihtsalt aed, vaid kaaslasi täis mängumaa. Koos Stellaga õpib Sam ruttu selgeks, et näpuotsatäie kujutlusvõimega on võimalik muuta tool kosmoseraketiks, et aasadel pesitsevad draakonid ja et puud võivad osutuda ideaalseteks piraadilaevadeks. Nende seikluste käigus tekib Samil alati palju küsimusi ja kuigi Stella ei pea kuigi palju faktidest kinni, ei jää ta nendele vastamisel kunagi hätta. Täna lööb Sam varba ära ja Stella keedab talle naljakatest asjadest rõõmusuppi.

programme.title: Tõene lugu
programme.desc: Michael Finkel (Jonah Hill) on ambitsioonikas ajakirjanik, kes saab The New York Timesist hundipassi artikli osalise fabritseerimise pärast, mis tähendab, et tema karjäär võib samahästi kui läbi olla. Järsku saab Finkel teada, et vahistatud on naise ja laste mõrvamises kahtlustatav mees nimega Christian Longo (James Franco), kes väitis end kinni pidamise käigus olevat reporter Michael Finkel. Ehtne Finkel teeb impulsiivse otsuse Longot vanglas külastada. Viimane väidab end olevat Finkeli suur fänn ning kinnitab viimasele, et on süütu. Finkeli ja Longo vahel tekib sõprussuhe ning Finkel hakkab kirjutama sellest raamatut, aga ajapikku hakkab ilmsiks tulema, et Longo pole ikka päris see, kes paistab...

programme.title: Kõik mängu
programme.desc: USA 2013 põnevik Lavastaja:Brad Furman Osades:Ben Affleck, Justin Timberlake, Gemma Arterton Selleks, et maksta oma õpingute eest mainekas Princetoni ülikoolis, kogub Richie (Justin Timberlake) raha internetikasiinodes. Algsest edust tiivustatuna läheb ta välja suure riski peale ning jääb kõigest ilma. Uskudes, et teda on petetud, lendab Richie eksootilisse Costa Ricasse, et nõuda aru netimängude magnaadilt Ivan Blockilt (Ben Affleck), kelle süsteemile ta kaotas.Richiet uimastab algselt Blocki külluslik elustiil: jahid, villad, kaunid naised, eralennukid, ning lubadus tohutust rikkusest, aga siis saab ta teada häiriva tõe oma võõrustaja kohta. Kui FBI püüab sundida Richiet aitama neid Blocki tabamisel, seisab poiss silmitsi oma senise elu suurima õnnemänguga: kuidas kavaldada üle kaks jõudu, mis mõlemad ähvardavad teda laiaks litsuda.
